canonicalEntities.name: Contact
canonicalEntities.role: Canonical person/identity. Unique key (workspaceId, phone). Holds CRM fields (leadScore, sentiment, purchaseProbability, aiSummary), a denormalized lead-funnel snapshot mirrored from KloelLead (leadStatus, leadStage, lastMessage, lastIntent, totalMessages), and provenance pointers to its lead sources (scrapingJobId, scrapedFrom, kloelLeadId, checkoutSocialLeadId). The intended single source of truth for the person.

canonicalEntities.name: ContactInsight
canonicalEntities.role: Append-only AI insight log per Contact (SENTIMENT_CHANGE, OBJECTION_RAISED, etc.) with scoreChange. Written by NeuroCrmService.createInsight.

canonicalEntities.name: ContactIdentityLink
canonicalEntities.role: Directed merge/link edge between two Contacts (contactId=target, linkedContactId=source) with confidence, matchReason, merged flag. Written ONLY by ContactIdentityMergeService.mergeContacts — which currently has no production caller (orphan).

canonicalEntities.name: ChannelIdentifier
canonicalEntities.role: Per-channel external identifier (WHATSAPP/INSTAGRAM/MESSENGER/EMAIL/TIKTOK -> value) pointing at a Contact. Unique key (workspaceId, channel, value). verifiedAt gates cross-channel match eligibility. Managed by ChannelIdentifierService + ContactIdentityResolverService.

canonicalEntities.name: KloelLead
canonicalEntities.role: Legacy/parallel lead funnel entity. Unique key (workspaceId, phone). Holds status/stage/score/lastMessage/lastIntent/totalMessages + KloelConversation history. Overlaps Contact almost entirely; bridged to Contact via Contact.kloelLeadId. Still the live backing store for the WhatsApp lead-processing path and the /kloel/leads list endpoint.

canonicalEntities.name: KloelConversation
canonicalEntities.role: Per-KloelLead message history (role/content/intent/sentiment). Legacy message surface; flag-gated dual-write mirrors into MindMessage (source='lead_conversation').

canonicalEntities.name: ScrapedLead
canonicalEntities.role: Raw scraper output (phone/name/category/address/metadata) tied to a ScrapingJob. isImported flag tracks promotion to Contact via ScrapersService.importLeads. NOT workspace-scoped directly (scoped via ScrapingJob).

canonicalEntities.name: CheckoutSocialLead
canonicalEntities.role: Social-login checkout lead capture (provider/providerId, email/phone/cpf, UTM/fbclid/gclid, enrichment, abandonment/recovery, conversion). Linked to Contact via contactId; Contact.checkoutSocialLeadId records reverse provenance. Has its own status/stage machine (CheckoutSocialLeadStatus).

canonicalEntities.name: Tag
canonicalEntities.role: Workspace-scoped label, many-to-many with Contact. Unique key (workspaceId, name). Upserted by CrmService.addTag and the inline addTagInline in crm.deals.helpers.

canonicalEntities.name: Pipeline / Stage / Deal
canonicalEntities.role: Sales Kanban. Deal -> Contact (contactId) + Stage. Managed by CrmService via crm.deals.helpers. Note: CRM read surface aliases Deal as 'lead' (getPipeline returns stage.leads = deals) — a naming overload distinct from KloelLead/ScrapedLead.

services.name: ChannelIdentifierService
services.responsibility: Resolve/create a Contact from a (channel,value) pair; link/find/setPrimary/markVerified channel identifiers. Synthesizes Contact.phone as `<channel>:<value>` when creating a contact with no real phone.

services.name: ContactIdentityResolverService
services.responsibility: Higher-level identity resolution: exact channel-identifier lookup, then cross-channel match by phone/email/socialHandle (only against verifiedAt!=null identifiers), else create. Used by commercial-decision-orchestrator.service.ts.

services.name: ContactIdentityMergeService
services.responsibility: Merge two Contacts: create ContactIdentityLink + re-point channelIdentifier/message/conversation/followUp/deal/flowExecution/autopilotEvent/checkoutSocialLead from source to target. ORPHAN: no production caller invokes mergeContacts.

services.name: CrmService
services.responsibility: CRM basics (create/upsert/get/list Contact, add/remove Tag) + pipeline/deal delegation to crm.deals.helpers + canonical Kloel-resolver methods (moveLead, openSupportTicket, listSupportTickets). upsertContact is the only Contact write that uses canonical structured normalizePhone.

services.name: NeuroCrmService
services.responsibility: AI lead analysis: analyzeContact (LLM -> leadScore/sentiment/purchaseProbability/summary/nextBestAction persisted to Contact + ContactInsight), nextBestAction, clusterLeads, simulateConversation, listInsights/createInsight.

services.name: CrmEventEmitterService
services.responsibility: Emits CRM/lead domain events to the Spine (commerce.crm.* and commerce.lead.objection_raised). Fail-open wrapper safeEmit.

services.name: OmnichannelContactResolutionService
services.responsibility: Thin adapter over ChannelIdentifierService: resolveFromMessage/findExisting/linkChannelToContact from a NormalizedMessage. Channel-value extraction heuristic (WHATSAPP/EMAIL use `from`, IG/MESSENGER use externalId).

services.name: KloelLeadProcessorService
services.responsibility: WhatsApp message -> KloelLead lifecycle + LLM reply + Contact dual-write mirror + payment generation. Owns getOrCreateLead-based lead path and the PERSON PHASE-1 Contact upsert.

services.name: LeadMindCoordinator
services.responsibility: Canonical per-lead cognitive coordinator: getOrCreateLead + syncCanonicalContact (KloelLead -> Contact dual-write) + funnel update. Wired in kloel.module.ts, used by kloel.service.ts. A near-duplicate of KloelLeadProcessorService.

services.name: WhatsAppMindCoordinator
services.responsibility: Per-channel WhatsApp coordinator: processWebhook/handleIncomingMessage -> getOrCreateLead(msg.from RAW) + syncCanonicalContact. Wired in kloel.module.ts and called by whatsapp-brain.controller.ts. THIRD getOrCreateLead implementation.

services.name: LeadsService
services.responsibility: Reads KloelLead rows and maps to a lead view-model with a heuristic commercialScore. Backs GET /kloel/leads/:workspaceId (the frontend 'leads' list). Reads from KloelLead, NOT Contact, despite the frontend type docstring claiming Contact-backing.

services.name: CheckoutSocialLeadService
services.responsibility: Capture/update/enrich/convert CheckoutSocialLead via social providers; syncs to Contact (upsertContact). Uses digitsOrNull (digits-only, NO BR promotion) for phone keying -> divergent Contact identity.

services.name: ScrapersService
services.responsibility: Promotes ScrapedLead rows into Contact via upsert on (workspaceId, raw phone). Sets customFields.source but does NOT set scrapingJobId/scrapedFrom provenance and does NOT normalize phone.

events: queue 'checkout-social-lead-enrich' on crmQueue (CheckoutSocialLeadService.enqueueEnrichment) — async enrichment job
autopilotEvent rows DEAL_WON / DEAL_WON_STAGE written by crm.deals.helpers.updateDeal/moveDeal (intent=REVENUE) + revenue webhook notifyRevenue

duplications.concept: Phone normalization semantics diverge across Contact-keying paths (BR-promotion vs digits-only vs raw)
duplications.canonicalChoice: normalizePhone() from backend/src/common/phone/phone-normalization.util.ts (structured, BR-promoting). All Contact (workspaceId, phone) writes MUST route through it.
duplications.note: A single BR person typing 11987654321 in WhatsApp lands as Contact.phone='5511987654321' (BR-promoted), but the SAME person via social checkout (digitsOrNull) lands as '11987654321', and via createDeal/scraper as the raw string. These produce DISTINCT Contact rows for one human -> identity fragmentation in production. checkout-social-lead aliases digitsOrNull AS the local name `normalizePhone`, which masks the divergence at the import site.

duplications.concept: KloelLead get-or-create passes un-normalized phone in the live WhatsApp coordinator path
implementations: kloel-lead-processor-helpers.getOrCreateLead:82 keyed on caller-supplied phone (processWhatsAppMessage passes normalizedPhone || senderPhone)
LeadMindCoordinator.getOrCreateLead:92 keyed on caller-supplied phone (line 319 passes normalizedPhone || senderPhone)
duplications.canonicalChoice: Normalize at the channel boundary before getOrCreateLead; consolidate the three getOrCreateLead bodies into one.
duplications.note: Because msg.from from WAHA may be a JID like 5511...@c.us or contain punctuation, WhatsAppMindCoordinator can create a KloelLead under a non-canonical phone while the lead-processor path creates another under the normalized phone -> two KloelLead rows + two Contact mirrors for one person. The unique (workspaceId, phone) constraint does NOT save this because the stored strings differ.

duplications.concept: processWhatsAppMessageWithPayment looks up KloelLead by RAW senderPhone while the lead was created under normalized phone
implementations: KloelLeadProcessorService.processWhatsAppMessageWithPayment lead lookup: prisma.kloelLead.findFirst({ where: { workspaceId, phone: senderPhone } }) RAW (line 285)
duplications.canonicalChoice: Use normalizePhone(senderPhone).digits for the lookup, matching getOrCreateLead.
duplications.note: When senderPhone is not already canonical (e.g. '(11) 98765-4321' or '11987654321'), the lead was stored as '5511987654321' but the payment-intent lookup queries the raw string -> findFirst returns null -> the high-buy-intent payment link is silently NOT generated. Lost-revenue bug.

duplications.concept: Two person/lead entities (Contact vs KloelLead) modeling the same human with overlapping funnel columns
duplications.canonicalChoice: Contact is the declared canonical person (PERSON migration). KloelLead funnel state is mirrored onto Contact via PHASE-1 dual-write + the historical backfill; KloelLead should become read-through/derived.
duplications.note: Dual-write is best-effort fail-open in 3 separate services, so the Contact mirror can silently drift from KloelLead. The list-leads UI reads KloelLead (LeadsService) while CRM reads Contact (CrmService) -> the two screens can show different funnel state for the same person. Migration is mid-flight (additive columns + backfill landed) but the cut-over is not complete.

duplications.concept: Three near-identical lead-lifecycle services (WhatsApp message -> KloelLead + Contact dual-write)
duplications.canonicalChoice: LeadMindCoordinator is annotated 'canonical per-lead cognitive coordinator'. Collapse the other two into it (or extract the shared getOrCreateLead + syncCanonicalContact into one helper).
duplications.note: All three implement getOrCreateLead + a PERSON-PHASE-1 syncCanonicalContact dual-write with the same docstring boilerplate but subtly different phone handling and lead-create payloads (name format, metadata.source, score seed). Maintenance hazard: a fix to dual-write logic must be applied in 3 places; they have already drifted (raw vs normalized phone, see P0 above).

duplications.concept: Two distinct contact-by-phone DTOs that are byte-identical
duplications.canonicalChoice: Keep one DTO (UpsertContactDto) and re-export/extend it; or make Create extend Upsert.
duplications.note: Same fields, same validators, same MaxLength. Pure copy. Low risk but they will drift.

duplications.concept: Tag upsert + connect duplicated outside CrmService
implementations: crm.deals.helpers.ts addTagInline (line 258, auto-tags 'cliente' on deal won)
duplications.note: addTagInline re-implements the tag upsert + contact.update connect inside a transaction. addTagInline keys the contact by (workspaceId, phone) using contact.phone read from the deal, inheriting whatever (possibly non-canonical) phone the Contact was stored under.

duplications.canonicalChoice: ContactIdentityResolverService for full resolution (it does cross-channel match); ChannelIdentifierService as its persistence primitive; OmnichannelContactResolutionService should delegate to the Resolver, not directly to ChannelIdentifierService.
duplications.note: OmnichannelContactResolutionService.resolveFromMessage calls ChannelIdentifierService.resolve directly, BYPASSING the cross-channel phone/email/socialHandle match in ContactIdentityResolverService. So an inbound message that should merge into an existing verified contact instead creates a new contact with a synthetic phone `<channel>:<value>` -> duplicate identities that only the (unused) merge service could later reconcile.

duplications.concept: Contact provenance bridge columns unwired in the scraped-lead import path
implementations: ScrapersService.importLeads contact.upsert (scrapers.service.ts:141) — sets customFields.source but never scrapingJobId/scrapedFrom
duplications.canonicalChoice: Set scrapingJobId + scrapedFrom on the upsert so the typed provenance bridge is populated (mirrors how kloelLeadId/checkoutSocialLeadId are wired elsewhere).
duplications.note: The schema added typed provenance pointers but the only ScrapedLead->Contact promoter writes lineage only into the untyped customFields.source JSON, leaving the indexed scrapingJobId column null -> the @@index([scrapingJobId]) and the ScrapingJobContacts relation are dead for imported contacts.
